text:
Elaine (CS): Heads up — enrolling Fintech Inc into the private preview for prefix-KV caching tomorrow. Need to confirm onboarding slot and feedback cadence. @Alice (Fintech) are you free for a 30m on Thu 10am PT?

Alice (Fintech): Thu 10 works for me. We'll need SSO set up and our IP ranges whitelisted. Also want SLI targets for latency improvements so we can evaluate impact.

Mohit (SE): I can handle SSO steps and the feature-flag flip. Can someone share dev creds for their staging workspace? Sam, do we have a pre-call checklist I can follow?

Sam (CSM): Yep checklist is ready — sending private link. We'll also send a 1-page pre-call guide and a tiny prompt set for perf baselining (5 inputs).

Devon (PM): Success criteria for this preview: 15-25% token cost reduction at parity or better output quality; no more than 5% quality regressions on the prompt set. We'll collect structured feedback after each session.

Elaine (CS): Draft feedback form below — keep it <1min to fill:
```
- workload_type: free text
- avg_seq_len: number
- perf_delta: percent
- quality_regressions: yes/no + short example
- next_action: checkbox (more tuning / rollback / deep-dive)
```
Can we shorten wording or drop anything redundant?

Mohit (SE): Keep it short. I'll toggle the flag to `beta/fintech-inc` tomorrow at 9:45am PT. deploy-bot will post confirmation after the flip. I'll also attach the SSO config steps in this thread.

deploy-bot: Feature flag `kv-cache-v2` toggled ON for tenant fintech-inc by Mohit at 2025-03-10T16:45:12Z :white_check_mark:

Alice (Fintech): Thanks — we'll run the baseline jobs overnight and share the perf CSV in the morning. Also can you provision workspace dashboards (token cost, p50/p95 latency, and sample outputs)?

Sam (CSM): Dashboard access granted, invite sent to alice@fintech.com. Weekly check-ins scheduled for Tuesdays 11am PT — calendar invite out.

Elaine (CS): Also flagging renewal risk: if Fintech Inc doesn't see roughly 10-15% unit-economy wins within the first 3 weeks, escalate for an enablement deep-dive. Marking them as high-touch for the first 30 days. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Alice (Fintech): :thumbsup: Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll report back tomorrow with CSV and the short form results.
